summary: Verified Welcome page + Footer responsiveness fix at phone widths (390px, 430px), tablet (768px), and desktop (1920px). All metrics pass: no horizontal overflow, footer heights within targets, social cards render in usable responsive grid, link columns readable and centered, disclaimer stays inside card above bottom bar. The fix from iteration_728 (using real viewport width for mobile dense-mode calculations) is working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Footer.tsx: footerViewportWidth correctly uses window.innerWidth on web instead of React Native layout width
useDensePhoneFooter threshold at width < 480 covers both 390px and 430px phone widths
useThreeColumnSocial activates at 430px+ for denser 3-column social presentation
useComfortableDensePhoneType activates at 360-430px for comfortable 2-column social presentation
All gap metrics (socialGap, linksGap, disclaimerGap) are within targets per iteration_728 verification
context_for_next_testing_agent: Welcome + Footer responsiveness fully verified. Root cause fix (using real viewport width on web for mobile dense-mode calculations) is working correctly. All phone widths (390px, 430px) show professional footer composition with no horizontal overflow, no collapsed/over-compressed presentation.

user_complaint_assessment.original_complaint: Welcome page, Footer page still not responsive across all devices. Lower closeout on phone widths.
user_complaint_assessment.root_cause_identified: Footer.tsx mobile dense/footer layout decisions were based on React Native layout width, which on web phone preview resolves to padded inner width instead of true viewport width. This caused 390px branch to over-trigger densest phone layout.
user_complaint_assessment.fix_applied: Phone dense-mode + responsive mobile footer calculations now use real viewport width on web (window.innerWidth). 390px uses comfortable 2-column social presentation, 430px+ uses denser 3-column pattern.
